headline: Strain episode likely in the next 72 hours
sentences: Meera's twin puts the chance of a strain episode in the next 72 hours at 71%, about twelve times her usual 6%.
The main reasons are overnight heart rate 9 bpm above her usual for 3 nights and home systolic BP rising 2.4 mmHg a day.
Her strongest lever is walking: 30 minutes a day is expected to lower her morning BP by about 6 mmHg.
next_step: Call today, confirm amlodipine is being taken (72% over 30 days), and ask for an evening BP reading.
